title: Trim the product backlog command to guided operations

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained synopsis test detected the omission of the callable `visit-consumers` operation.

SEED-423#trim-the-product-backlog-command-to-guided-operations at `fe24f8795993b18e8a4c16896d1fbef194f6aeab` promises a command synopsis that covers every supported operation. The canonical SEED-423 story section and plan 820 both identify dependency discovery and visiting as part of this coverage.

In a detached scratch checkout at that revision, a temporary edit at `Distribution/src/skills/dough-product-backlog/scripts/product-backlog.mjs:89` filtered `visit-consumers` from the usage rendering. The live registry still dispatched the verb. Independent direct CLI calls confirmed that `--help` lost only the visit operation and its options continuation, while invoking `visit-consumers` without arguments still reached its missing supplier identity refusal.

All three runs used `env PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" caffeinate -s -i bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/tests/support/product-backlog-help.test.mjs` on AC power. The baseline passed all three cases. With the fault, the case “backlog help gives all operations in a short synopsis with a route to guidance” failed on the exact operation membership assertion at `Distribution/tests/support/product-backlog-help.test.mjs:19`. The two refusal cases passed. The test's existing scratch project fixture executes the real CLI and its assertions and fixture were untouched. After restoration, the CLI help matched the baseline byte-for-byte, Git showed the original clean state, and all three cases passed again. The scratch worktree was removed.

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing membership assertion for this path. The result confirms the delivered replacement for the retired help-format assertion. It adds no new proof work for the observed omission.

Logs, command output, and the temporary diff are retained under `/tmp/dough-423-wrapup.wAW9ZS/intent-evidence`.

- **Test runtime.** The runner reported 0.5 seconds for the single test job in each phase, measured at its reporting precision. Command wall times, measured with Bash `time`, were 0.623 seconds at baseline, 0.617 seconds with the fault, and 0.604 seconds after restoration.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. The probe required no observed human action and no separate human-effort timing was collected.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. There was no separate active-effort measurement beyond invocation elapsed.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 88727 ms (measured), from 1795565174000 to 1795565262727 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: Checked fe24f8795993b18e8a4c16896d1fbef194f6aeab. Caught. Keep the synopsis membership assertion. No follow-up.
